race.title: AWC Season 14 Handicap
race.verdict: SOVEREIGN BAY went like the best horse at the weights when narrowly denied on his yard debut over this C&D 21 days ago. The stable has an excellent record with this type of recruit and he can gain quick compensation. Hitched has won twice over C&D and is feared most after hinting at a revival last time, while Galba will find life tougher under a penalty but is respected. SOVEREIGN BAY (FR) HITCHED (IRE) GALBA
race.bettingForecast: Galba (2/1), Sovereign Bay (5/2), Hitched (8/1), Law Supreme (10/1), Shadowmere (10/1), Pipily (12/1), He's A Gentleman (12/1), Ecclefechan (12/1), Galileo Island (20/1), Clatford (50/1)
